# Phase 1 sweeps (generated by `make sweep`; do not edit)

Baseline die: 1.57 PFLOPS FP8 peak, 4.92 TB/s HBM peak, 144 GB; roofline uses MXU efficiency 0.8 and HBM efficiency 0.85 -> sustained ops:byte 301. Serving point: 64 sequences x 128K context, >= 50 tokens/s per user, no speculative decoding, `fp8` deployment. Raw data: `build/phase1/*.csv`.

## 1. When do MoE layers become compute-bound?

Expert GEMM intensity is 2 x tokens-per-expert FLOPs per weight byte, so the crossover is `tokens/expert = sustained ops:byte x bytes per weight / 2` (BF16 also halves the MXU rate).

| weights | bytes/weight | tokens per expert at crossover |
|---|---|---|
| fp8 | 1.0 | 150.6 |
| nvfp4 | 0.5625 | 84.7 |
| mxfp4 | 0.5312 | 80.0 |
| bf16 | 2.0 | 150.6 |

Tokens in flight per EP group (decode batch x draft tokens) needed for every expert to reach the crossover under uniform routing, at the `fp8` deployment:

| model | experts | top-k | expert dtype | tokens/expert | tokens per step |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek V4.1 Flash | 384 | 6 | mxfp4 | 80.0 | 5120 |
| GLM-5.3 | 256 | 8 | fp8 | 150.6 | 4819 |
| GLM-5.3-Flash | 288 | 8 | fp8 | 150.6 | 5421 |
| Ling 3.1 Flash | 512 | 8 | fp8 | 150.6 | 9638 |
| MiMo-V2.6-Flash | 256 | 8 | mxfp4 | 80.0 | 2560 |
| MiMo-V2.6-Pro | 384 | 8 | mxfp4 | 80.0 | 3840 |
| MiniMax-M3.1-Flash | 128 | 4 | nvfp4 | 84.7 | 2710 |
| Mistral Large 4 | 128 | 4 | fp8 | 150.6 | 4819 |
| Muse Spark Open | 256 | 8 | fp8 | 150.6 | 4819 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 512 | 10 | fp8 | 150.6 | 7710 |
| Step 5 Preview | 352 | 8 | fp8 | 150.6 | 6626 |

## 5. Speculative decoding

Acceptance from `npumodel.specdec` (DSpark paper Table 1, Qwen3-8B, code domain); drafter cost from the op graph (drafter layers, the target LM head over the draft positions, the Markov head). Verification runs gamma + 1 tokens per sequence through the target.

| model | method | best gamma | tau | tokens/s/user | speed-up |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MiniMax-M3.1-Flash | dspark | 7 | 5.28 | 555.8 | 2.73 |
| MiMo-V2.6-Flash | dflash | 7 | 4.46 | 346.6 | 2.19 |
| DeepSeek V4.1 Flash | dspark | 5 | 4.43 | 524.0 | 1.66 |
| Mistral Large 4 | dspark | 3 | 3.32 | 200.6 | 1.76 |
| GLM-5.3-Flash | mtp | 3 | 2.95 | 165.5 | 1.37 |
